mapper.select: SELECT id, name, icon, emoji, order_num, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM api_doc_categories WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND is_active = true ORDER BY order_num ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_doc_categories (name, icon, emoji, order_num, is_active, team_id) VALUES (#{category.name}, #{category.icon}, #{category.emoji}, #{category.orderNum}, #{category.isActive}, #{teamId})
